.github/workflows/pages.yml.scope: Obtain the exact currently served manifest with bounded retries, then verify the same artifact that is uploaded. Use the full archive when the live manifest is unavailable.

scripts/build-github-pages.cjs.scope: Keep all content files byte-identical and apply reader retention only in the project-site deployment copy.

scripts/check-github-pages.cjs.scope: Verify exact deployed and archived asset inventories and byte hashes, the live reader closure, all legacy bootstraps and every existing public local link.

scripts/pages-reader-retention.cjs.scope: Retain the current and three recent distinct complete dependency sets, the exact known live dependency set, and all historical fallback bootstraps. Unknown live manifests select the full archive.

README.md.scope: State the compact deployment policy and how older open tabs get the current search index.

deployment_checks.desktop_mobile: Exact live predecessor HTML hydrated its original lightweight reader and searched. An older cached article whose runtime was not retained entered full fallback and searched.
